### River Mile 6 Instream Temperature

Currently 2012-04-23 - 2025-10-17

```{r include=FALSE}
monitoring_location_id <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","historical-temperature", "2023_UDWC_WQM-ContTemp-_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "Monitoring_Locations")
# 2025

# TODO: for 2024 and 2025 - there are three sheets with 006-00 (WC_006-00_21629136, WC_006-00_21555606, WC_006-00_21564982)
# Should I pull all of them and average? 
rm6_2025_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw", "historical-temperature",  "2025_UDWC_Continuous_Temperature_Data_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "WC_006-00_21629136", skip = 3) |> 
  select(date = DATE, temperature = TEMP_r) |> 
  mutate(date = as_datetime(date)) 

# 2024
rm6_2024_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","historical-temperature", "2024_UDWC_Continuous_Temperature_Data_Trimmed_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "WC_006-00 21629136", skip = 3) |> 
  select(date = DATE, temperature = TEMP_r) |> 
  mutate(date = as_datetime(date)) 

rm6_2023_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","historical-temperature", "2023_UDWC_WQM-ContTemp-_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "Results") |> 
  mutate(`Monitoring Location ID` = as.character(`Monitoring Location ID`)) |> 
  left_join(monitoring_location_id |> 
              select(`Monitoring Location ID`, `Monitoring Location Name`)) |> 
  filter(`Monitoring Location Name` == "WC_006-00")   # filter for the RM6 site

rm6_2022_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","historical-temperature", "2022_UDWC_WQM-ContTemp _FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "Results") |> 
  mutate(`Monitoring Location ID` = as.character(`Monitoring Location ID`)) |> 
  left_join(monitoring_location_id |> 
              select(`Monitoring Location ID`, `Monitoring Location Name`)) |> 
  filter(`Monitoring Location Name` == "WC_006-00") # filter for the RM6 site

rm6_2025_2022 <- bind_rows(rm6_2023_raw,
                           rm6_2022_raw) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  rename(date = activity_start_date,
         temperature = result_value) |> 
  select(date, temperature) |> 
  bind_rows(rm6_2024_raw, rm6_2025_raw)

# rm6_2021_raw_1 <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","UDWC_2021_ContinuousDataSubmission_Trimmed_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "WC_006-00 20423312", range = "A5:C1830")
rm6_2021_raw_2 <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","historical-temperature", "UDWC_2021_ContinuousDataSubmission_Trimmed_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "WC_006-00 20423310", range = "A5:C1040") |> 
  rename(Date = DATE,
         Time = TIME,
         Temp = TEMP_r)


rm6_2020_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","historical-temperature", "UDWC_2020_ContinuousDataSubmission_Trimmed_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "WC_006-00 20423294", range = "A5:C5092") |> 
  rename(Date = DATE,
         Time = TIME,
         Temp = TEMP_r)


rm6_2019_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","historical-temperature", "UDWC_2019_ContinuousTemperature_TrimmedData_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "WC_006.00_10792864", range = "A5:C4694") |> 
  rename(Date = DATE,
         Time = TIME,
         Temp = TEMP_r)


rm6_2018_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","historical-temperature", "UDWC_2018_ContinuousDataSubmittal_3.0_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "WC_006-00_354425", range = "A5:C5264") |> 
  rename(Date = DATE,
         Time = TIME,
         Temp = TEMP_r)


rm6_2017_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","historical-temperature", "UDWC_2017_ContinuousDataSubmittalTemplate_3.0-Final.xlsx"), sheet = "WC_006-00_353753", range = "A5:C3511") |> 
  rename(Date = DATE,
         Time = TIME,
         Temp = TEMP_r)

rm6_2016_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","historical-temperature", "UDWC-Cont-Temp-2016","WC_006-00.xlsx"), sheet = "354424 Data") |> 
  rename(Temp = `Temp (°C)`)

rm6_2015_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","historical-temperature", "2015-UDWC-Cont-Temp-Data","WC_006-00.xlsx"), sheet = "354426 Data") |> 
  rename(Temp = `Temp (°C)`)

rm6_2014_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","historical-temperature", "2014","WC_006-00.xlsx"), sheet = "3544424 Data") |> 
  rename(Date = `Date(yyyy-mm-dd)`,
         Time = `Time(hh:mm:ss)`,
         Temp = `Temperature (°C)`)

rm6_2013_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","historical-temperature", "2013","WC_006-00.xlsx"), sheet = "353754 Data") |> 
  rename(Temp = `°C`)

rm6_2012_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","historical-temperature", "2012","WC_006-00.xlsx"), sheet = "4673") |> 
  mutate(Temp = as.numeric(Temp))

rm6_2012_2021 <- bind_rows(rm6_2012_raw,
                           rm6_2013_raw,
                           rm6_2014_raw,
                           rm6_2015_raw,
                           rm6_2016_raw,
                           rm6_2017_raw,
                           rm6_2018_raw,
                           rm6_2019_raw,
                           rm6_2020_raw,
                           rm6_2021_raw_2) |> 
  rename(date = Date,
         temperature = Temp) |> 
  select(date, temperature)

rm6_full_2012_2025 <- bind_rows(rm6_2025_2022,
                                rm6_2012_2021) |> 
  group_by(date) |> 
  summarize(mean = mean(temperature, na.rm = T),
            median = median(temperature, na.rm = T),
            max = max(temperature, na.rm = T),
            min = min(temperature, na.rm = T)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = mean:min, values_to = "temperature", names_to = "statistic")

rm_6_historical <- rm6_full_2012_2025

usethis::use_data(rm_6_historical, overwrite = T)

```

```{r}
rm_6_historical |> 
  group_by(year = year(date)) |> 
  summarise(mean_temperature = mean(temperature, na.rm = T),
            min_temperature = min(temperature, na.rm = T),
            max_temperature = max(temperature, na.rm = T)) |> 
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)

ggplot() + 
  geom_line(data = rm_6_historical, aes(x = date, y = temperature, color = statistic)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_small) +
  theme_minimal()

```

### Camp Polk Instream Temperature and Discharge

Currently pulled from OWRD 2015-10-01 - 2026-03-29

```{r eval=FALSE}
cp_daily_mean_temperature <-  get_owrd_hydro(
  station_nbr = "14076100",
  start_date = '2015-01-01',
  end_date = Sys.Date()-1,
  data_source = "WTEMP_MEAN"
) |> 
  rename(value = daily_mean_water_temp_c) |> 
  mutate(variable = "water temperature (c)",
         statistic = "mean",
         location = "camp polk") |> 
  glimpse()


cp_daily_min_temperature <-  get_owrd_hydro(
  station_nbr = "14076100",
  start_date = '2015-01-01',
  end_date = Sys.Date()-1,
  data_source = "WTEMP_MIN"
) |> 
  rename(value = daily_min_water_temp_f) |> 
  mutate(variable = "water temperature (c)",
         statistic = "min",
         location = "camp polk") |> 
  select(-time_observed) |> 
  glimpse()

cp_daily_max_temperature <-  get_owrd_hydro(
  station_nbr = "14076100",
  start_date = '2015-01-01',
  end_date = Sys.Date()-1,
  data_source = "WTEMP_MAX"
) |> 
  rename(value = daily_max_water_temp_c) |> 
  mutate(variable = "water temperature (c)",
         statistic = "max",
         location = "camp polk") |> 
  select(-time_observed) |> 
  glimpse()

cp_mean_daily_flow <-  get_owrd_hydro(
  station_nbr = "14076100",
  start_date = '2015-01-01',
  end_date = Sys.Date()-1,
  data_source = "MDF"
) |> 
  rename(value = mean_daily_flow_cfs) |> 
  mutate(variable = "discharge (cfs)",
         statistic = "mean",
         location = "camp polk") |> 
  glimpse()

camp_polk_historical <- bind_rows(
  cp_daily_max_temperature,
  cp_daily_min_temperature,
  cp_daily_mean_temperature,
  cp_mean_daily_flow
) |> 
  rename(date = record_date) |> 
  mutate(date = as.Date(
    parse_date_time(date, orders = c("mdy", "mdy HM"))
    )) |> 
  glimpse()

usethis::use_data(camp_polk_historical, overwrite = T)

```

```{r}
whychusInputs::camp_polk_historical |> 
  group_by(year = year(date), statistic, variable) |> 
  summarise(n_values = n()) |> 
  knitr::kable()

ggplot() + 
  geom_line(data = whychusInputs::camp_polk_historical, aes(x = date, y = value, color = statistic)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_small) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y") + 
  theme_minimal()

```

### Historical weather forecasts

Historical NWS weather forecasts were obtained from the [Open-Meteo Historical Forecast API](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/historical-forecast-api), which archives operational GFS (Global Forecast System) model output — the same underlying model used by NWS to generate official forecasts. While NWS applies additional post-processing (Model Output Statistics and forecaster adjustments) before issuing public forecasts, the raw GFS output accessed through Open-Meteo represents the same meteorological signal and is expected to differ from official NWS values by only 1–3°C on any given day. For the purposes of this analysis, GFS-based forecasts are considered a suitable proxy for NWS forecast inputs given their shared model foundation and the daily temporal resolution of the model.

```{r eval=FALSE}
# Single month test — run this first
one_month_historical <- get_historical_forecast(
  lat        = 44.390278,
  lon        = -121.406792,
  start_date = "2023-07-01",
  end_date   = "2023-07-31",
  lead_days  = c(1, 3, 7)
)

glimpse(one_month_historical)

# Full 2020 to present run
all_historical_forecasts <- get_historical_forecast_range(
  lat        = 44.390278,
  lon        = -121.406792,
  start_date = "2020-01-01",
  end_date   = Sys.Date(),
  lead_days  = c(1, 3, 7),
  save_dir   = "data-raw/historical_forecasts"
)

usethis::use_data(all_historical_forecasts, overwrite = T)

```

```{r echo=FALSE}
plot_data <- whychusInputs::all_historical_forecasts |>
  mutate(
    month     = month(valid_date, label = TRUE),
    year      = year(valid_date),
    lead_days = factor(lead_days, levels = c(1, 3, 7),
                       labels = c("Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
    variable  = recode(variable,
                       "temperature_2m_max" = "Max air temp (°C)",
                       "temperature_2m_min" = "Min air temp (°C)",
                       "cloud_cover_mean"   = "Cloud cover (%)"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(month, variable, lead_days) |>
  summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# --- Colors -------------------------------------------------------------

lead_colors <- c(
  "Day 1" = "#E24B4A",
  "Day 3" = "#888780",
  "Day 7" = "#378ADD"
)

# --- Plot ---------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = month, y = mean_value,
                      color = lead_days, group = lead_days)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = lead_colors, name = "Lead time") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    title    = "GFS historical forecast — 44.39°N, 121.41°W",
    subtitle = "Monthly mean by forecast lead time, 2020–present",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = NULL,
    caption  = "Source: Open-Meteo Historical Forecast API (GFS seamless)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position  = "top",
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40"),
    plot.caption     = element_text(color = "grey60", size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing    = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )
```
